body: Resume note: the first author answers are in BALDADOON_AUTHOR_INTERVIEW_20261101.json (answers B, K, O and the unasked S, each with the author's words, the writer's decision, scope and follow-ups). Present day with smartphones; Massachusetts State Police and the FBI as written; one film; John's car a present-day unmarked sedan. Addendum A to the set camera maps carries the set consequences (the IMPALA family's identity for all 31 batch-1 stills; screens dark; marked SUVs in batch 2); I am posting it to the Pent House as the writer's correction within the round Ziggy opened. The 202 card corrections in the delta TSV and the 11.2 bindings wait for you as before; when you wire the interview file to the site's interview section, the answers array is the one to show.
